svg.title: P005 · Orders placed in Q1 2025
svg.desc: One row per order placed in Q1 2025. Order 1 is from December and drops out. January 1 qualifies exactly at the lower boundary. March 31 stays and April 1 drops out. Orders 2 and 3 are the quarter's two orders. FROM Orders · one table is enough. The date that decides eligibility and the amount to display both belong to an order. Its customer ID is already recorded on that same row.
svg.text: One row per order placed in Q1 2025.
Which side of the quarter boundary contains an order dated April 1?
A triangle marks an example to follow. A dark source band spans its columns. ƒ marks a calculated value. Deeper cell colors mark the values to
follow. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
